title: Discrete Choice under Congestion: Equilibrium and Welfare
abstract: arXiv:2611.07787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many choice settings, a rise in aggregate demand for an option lowers an individual's payoff from choosing it. Driving becomes less attractive than taking a train when more commuters drive, clogging the highway. In such cases, a targeted intervention that mitigates the externality at the congested option can divert it elsewhere and also undermine preference based sorting, making overall welfare effects theoretically ambiguous. We develop an empirical framework to analyze such scenarios of endogenous congestion. We show that in these settings, equilibrium exists and is unique without restrictions on functional-form of utilities or dimension/distribution of preference heterogeneity, and even when congestion at one option affects payoffs from other choices. translated_title: 拥堵下的离散选择：均衡与福利
translated_abstract: 在许多选择情境中，某一选项的总需求上升会降低个体选择该选项的收益。当更多通勤者选择开车时，高速公路变得拥堵，开车相比乘坐火车的吸引力随之下降。在这类情境中，旨在缓解拥堵选项外部性的针对性干预可能会将需求转移至其他选项，并破坏基于偏好的分类机制，使得总体福利效应在理论上是不确定的。我们开发了一个实证框架来分析此类内生拥堵情境。我们证明，在这些情境下均衡存在且唯一，且无需对效用的函数形式或偏好异质性的维度与分布施加任何限制，即使某一选项的拥堵会影响其他选择的收益时也是如此。在线性指数结构下，关于选择的微观数据能够实现效用对比以及部分（但非全部）干预措施福利效应的半参数识别。我们将该框架应用于……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: 本文构建了内生拥堵情境下的离散选择实证框架，证明在不对效用函数形式和偏好异质性施加任何限制的条件下均衡存在且唯一，并给出了部分干预措施福利效应的半参数识别条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an empirical framework for discrete choice under endogenous congestion, proving equilibrium existence and uniqueness without restrictions on utility functional forms or preference heterogeneity, and establishing semiparametric identification of the welfare effects of some interventions.
